value: In the modafinil condition, none of the a priori ROIs showed greater activation in cocaine-dependent patients than healthy controls for cocaine-related versus neutral pictures, and healthy controls did not show greater activation either. value: Within cocaine-dependent patients, modafinil versus placebo decreased activation in the midbrain region including the VTA/SN and increased activation in the right ACC, with a trend toward increased activation in the putamen. Modafinil-induced increases in ACC and putamen activation were associated with decreases in cue-induced craving, suggesting diminished motivational responsiveness and increased cognitive control during cocaine-cue exposure.

spans.text: Functional images of each individual subject were realigned in order to correct for motion. A mean functional image was constructed for each subject from the realigned images. These mean images were co-registered with the structural MRI image and then segmented for normalization to an MNI (Montreal Neurological Institute) template. Finally, images were smoothed using a Gaussian kernel of 8 mm at full width at half maximum (FWHM).
